_readme: Source of truth for the DueDay Tax app's remote date table (apps/due-day-tax/store/rules.json -> axnoapp-crypto.github.io/dueday/rules.json).
m/d = nominal date for calendar-year filers; the app moves weekend and DC-holiday dates to the next business day itself.
Replace the whole file or nothing: the app discards a table with an unknown id, a bad date or fewer than 5 rules.
Change asOf whenever the dates are re-checked against irs.gov/filing/when-to-file and irs.gov/payments/estimated-taxes.
Valid ids: q4 p1065 f1040 f1120 q1 q2 q3 x1065 x1040 q4c. who: w2 free part corp. kind: file pay ext.
